newsitem.title: USA: Palm Beach Cty, Fla., to sell $23 mln seaport revs.
newsitem.headline: Palm Beach Cty, Fla., to sell $23 mln seaport revs.

text.p: Raymond James & Associates as senior manager said it expects to price on Thursday a $23 million revenue bond issue for Florida's Port of Palm Beach.
The issue will be insured by MBIA, according to the preliminary official statement.
Bond proceeds will be used to finance land purchases, expansions and improvements at the seaport, with debt service paid from gross revenues.
The seaport district has also been awarded a $17.3 million grant from the Florida Sepaort Transportation and Economic development Council for the expansion project.
